title: The Fake Vermeer That Fooled Göring: The Painter Who Saved Himself
summary: Tells how Han van Meegeren, a Dutch painter the critics looked down on, fooled first the art world and then Hermann Göring with fake Vermeers made from Bakelite-based paints and canvases baked in an oven. The episode covers his trial for treason in 1945, when he confessed the painting was a forgery to escape execution, the new Vermeer he painted in front of witnesses to prove it, and his fraud trial in 1947.
